title: Empirical Evaluation of Data Poisoning Attacks in Supervised Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.10952v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data poisoning corrupts training data to degrade a model or to plant attacker-controlled behavior. This study evaluates two representative training-time attacks, label flipping and backdoor poisoning, on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST with three baseline classifiers: Logistic Regression, Linear SVM, and Random Forest. Clean training is compared with poisoning rates of 5%, 10%, and 20% using clean-test accuracy, macro-precision, macro-recall, macro-F1, and, for backdoors, attack success rate. Label flipping caused clear degradation, largest for Logistic Regression and Linear SVM, while Random Forest stayed comparatively stable. Backdoor poisoning reached attack success rates from 0.9667 to 1.0000 on both datasets and all three models while often keeping clean-test performance near baseline. translated_title: 监督学习中数据投毒攻击的实证评估
translated_abstract: 数据投毒通过污染训练数据来降低模型性能或植入攻击者控制的行为。本研究在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上，使用三种基线分类器（逻辑回归、线性支持向量机和随机森林），评估了两种代表性的训练时攻击方法：标签翻转和后门投毒。研究使用干净测试准确率、宏平均精确率、宏平均召回率、宏平均F1分数，以及针对后门攻击的攻击成功率，将干净训练与5%、10%和20%的投毒率进行了比较。标签翻转造成了明显的性能下降，对逻辑回归和线性支持向量机的影响最大，而随机森林相对稳定。后门投毒在两个数据集和所有三种模型上的攻击成功率达到0.9667至1.0000，同时通常使干净测试性能保持在接近基线的水平。研究结果区分了在标准指标中会显现的无差别投毒与保持相对隐蔽的针对性后门投毒。
tldr: 本研究实证评估了标签翻转与后门投毒两种攻击，发现标签翻转会造成明显性能下降（对线性模型影响最大），而后门投毒攻击成功率接近100%却几乎不影响干净测试性能，隐蔽性极强。
en_tdlr: This empirical evaluation of label flipping and backdoor poisoning attacks shows that label flipping causes clear degradation (largest for linear models), while backdoor poisoning achieves 96.7%-100% attack success rates while keeping clean-test performance near baseline, demonstrating strong stealth.
